verdict.rationale: Browserbase runs agent jobs on a schedule or on demand and claims observability through rich logs, live view and session replay. Webhooks push status-change events to your own endpoint, which can drive failure alerts. However, there is no evidence of data-quality validation or job-level performance metrics, and alerting is a build-your-own webhook integration rather than native alerting. Missing for 10: data quality validation or checks, job performance metrics or dashboards, native failure alerting (the webhook payload is not shown to cover run failures), independent corroboration.
